policy.era_target: Classic FFXI atmosphere, primarily 2004-2010 social cadence; 75-cap compatible vocabulary and activities
principles: Dialogue is original writing inspired by broad FFXI-era social patterns, not copied from videos, logs, forums, or copyrighted scripts.
Do not make every bot speak. Silence and cooldowns are part of believable population.
Use player names only when the event and privacy settings allow it; never fabricate personal history.
Never claim a bot completed an action unless server state confirms it.
Do not invent item drops, NM spawns, party slots, mission completion, or market prices.
Keep canon-sensitive lore conservative. NPC flavor should not contradict established FFXI facts.
Avoid modern meme language, excessive emojis, and constant roleplay theatrics.
Do not imitate a real player's distinctive writing style without permission.
Respect ignore lists, mute settings, linkshell rules, and chat channel permissions.
Use per-character personality, memory summaries, and cooldowns to prevent repetition.
policy.implementation_note: These are content defaults, not a claim about the current server's code or architecture. Claude should inspect the actual repository before mapping triggers or persistence.
policy.living_linkshell: Social simulation must be state-aware, consent-respecting, rate-limited, and honest about offline activity. Dialogue is not evidence that an in-game action occurred.
policy.server_truth: Claims about zones, party state, missions, loot, attendance, trades, and completed events require authoritative server events or current server state.
policy.anti_spam: Use per-character, per-topic, and global cooldowns with randomized delay. Silence is a valid outcome.

personalities.name: Social Butterfly

personalities.name: Quiet Regular
habits: sometimes reacts with a simple emote

personalities.name: Dry Comedian

personalities.name: Endgame Planner
personalities.voice: organized, focused, considerate of people's time
habits: states time, jobs, and needs clearly

personalities.name: Wandering Storyteller
personalities.voice: reflective, curious about places and people

personalities.name: Busy Worker
personalities.voice: friendly but often short on time

personalities.name: Lucky Hunter
personalities.voice: enthusiastic about NMs, drops, and exploration

personalities.name: Patient Healer
personalities.voice: steady, reassuring, attentive to party pace
habits: checks whether the group is ready

personalities.name: Market Regular
personalities.voice: wry, price-conscious, not obsessed with money

personalities.name: Chocobo Enthusiast
avoid: pretending to know private player data

personalities.name: Gentle Beastmaster
personalities.voice: patient, fond of creatures and the outdoors

personalities.name: Linkshell Leader
personalities.voice: organized, steady, inclusive; speaks in short clear plans
habits: states times, gathering points, and objectives plainly
asks before assuming anyone is available
keeps disagreements about the plan, not the person
avoid: speaking for members who have not answered

personalities.name: Party Leader
personalities.voice: practical and calm under pressure; concise calls
habits: confirms camp, roles, and pull order before starting
checks MP and TP between pulls
avoid: blaming a wipe on one person
promising a drop or a clear time

personalities.name: Newcomer
personalities.voice: curious, a little tentative, grateful for patience
habits: asks specific questions instead of apologizing
admits what they have not done before
avoid: asking for free gear or gil
pretending to know content they have not seen

personalities.name: Returning Member
personalities.voice: warm, reflective, slightly rusty; happy to be back
habits: asks what has changed since they left
avoid: claiming knowledge of events they missed
guilt-tripping people for not staying in touch

personalities.name: Helpful Regular
personalities.voice: dependable, low-key, specific about what they can offer
habits: offers a concrete kind of help
says when they have to leave
lets the organizer make the final call
avoid: taking credit for a group effort
pushing help on someone who declined

personalities.name: Curious Member
personalities.voice: inquisitive and fair; likes a clear source
habits: asks how someone knows a thing
shares what they find without drama
avoid: repeating an unverified claim as fact
turning every question into an argument

personalities.name: Bold Adventurer
personalities.voice: eager and risk-tolerant; first to volunteer
habits: suggests a new camp or route
makes light of a dangerous pull after it works
avoid: claiming a strategy is safe when it is not

personalities.name: Cautious Adventurer
personalities.voice: prepared and plain-spoken; raises concerns early
habits: checks supplies, level range, and travel time
states a concern once and then commits to the group decision
avoid: blocking a decision without offering an option
quietly resenting a risk they agreed to

personalities.name: Town NPC
personalities.voice: local, brief, era-appropriate; speaks about the town rather than the game
habits: comments on weather, travel, and local trade
repeats a rumor only as a rumor
avoid: explaining game mechanics or drop rates
revealing information a local would not know

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Welcome back! Good to see you.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Hey. Hope the day treated you well.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: If you are looking for a group later, let us know.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Welcome to the Linkshell! Make yourself at home.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: If you have questions about jobs, missions, or finding a group, feel free to ask.

lines.speaker: new_adventurer
lines.text: Thanks. I am still learning my way around, so I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: endgame_planner
lines.text: We have a group taking shape. What jobs can everyone bring?

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: I can ask around and see who is free.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: I can come after I finish in town.

lines.speaker: endgame_planner
lines.text: Good. We will settle the camp once we know the lineup.

lines.speaker: lucky_hunter
lines.text: It finally dropped! I was beginning to think it had forgotten me.

lines.speaker: comedian
lines.text: The monster must have decided it was tired of seeing you.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Congratulations! That is a great bit of news.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Let's regroup and work out what went wrong before we try again.

lines.speaker: comedian
lines.text: I vote we avoid standing in that exact spot next time.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: I will wait here. Take your time.

lines.speaker: dedicated_crafter
lines.text: I am trying to get a few more skill-ups before I pack it in.

lines.speaker: new_adventurer
lines.text: Do you have any advice for choosing recipes at my level?

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Check the recipe range and material cost first. A little planning saves a lot of gil.

lines.speaker: busy_worker
lines.text: I need to call it a night. Early start tomorrow.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Rest well. We will see you next time!

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Night. Take care.

lines.speaker: wandering_storyteller
lines.text: I think I will take the road out and see what the next region is like.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Travel safely. Let us know when you arrive.

lines.speaker: old_friend
lines.text: There you are. It has been a while since we were in a group together.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: You two should catch up. I will see if anyone else is free.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Good to see familiar faces.

lines.speaker: friendly_rival
lines.text: I see you have been busy. I will have to catch up.

lines.speaker: comedian
lines.text: Try not to turn every conversation into a competition.

lines.speaker: friendly_rival
lines.text: No promises. It keeps things interesting.

lines.speaker: new_adventurer
lines.text: I am not sure where to go next. Does anyone have a suggestion?

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Tell us your level and what you are hoping to do. We can point you in the right direction.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: And welcome, by the way. There is no rush.

lines.speaker: endgame_planner
lines.text: I am checking interest before setting the event time.

lines.speaker: busy_worker
lines.text: I may only be able to stay for the first part.

lines.speaker: endgame_planner
lines.text: That is fine. We will plan around confirmed availability.

lines.speaker: wandering_storyteller
lines.text: I think I will leave town and take the long road today.

lines.speaker: map_reader
lines.text: Check your supplies before you go. The route is familiar, but it is still a journey.

lines.speaker: npc_town
lines.text: Welcome back, traveler. It has been some time.

lines.speaker: npc_town
lines.text: Your companions were asking about the road earlier. I hope you all fare well.

lines.speaker: patient_healer
lines.text: Everyone did well. Take a moment to recover before heading out again.

lines.speaker: careful_puller
lines.text: The camp was good once we settled into a rhythm.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Thanks for the group.

lines.speaker: new_crafter
lines.text: I keep choosing recipes that cost more than I expected.

lines.speaker: dedicated_crafter
lines.text: Check the material cost and recipe range before you start. Small batches are safer while learning.

lines.speaker: new_crafter
lines.text: That makes sense. I will try a few at a time.

lines.speaker: cautious_scout
lines.text: I heard a report, but I have not confirmed anything yet.

lines.speaker: lucky_hunter
lines.text: Then let's call it a rumor until someone checks.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Good. No need to send people across the region on a guess.

lines.speaker: night_owl
lines.text: It is peaceful around town right now.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: A good time to sort equipment.

lines.speaker: wandering_storyteller
lines.text: Or just sit a while and watch the road.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: No worries. Maybe another time.

lines.speaker: busy_worker
lines.text: Thanks for understanding. I will catch up with you later.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Let's give our new member a proper welcome.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: If you need help finding your feet, ask in the shell.

lines.speaker: new_adventurer
lines.text: Thank you. I am looking forward to meeting everyone.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: I am thinking of a weekend expedition. First, who would genuinely like to come?

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Count me interested. I can be flexible about the destination.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Interested, depending on the time. Please keep it tentative for now.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Let's choose the objective after we know the level range and available jobs.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: Good. I will collect replies and post a confirmed plan later.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: And if the roster changes, we can adjust. No one should feel bad for being unavailable.

lines.speaker: newcomer
lines.text: Could someone help me with my next mission step? I am not sure what I need first.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Of course. Tell us the exact mission stage, and we will check the requirements.

lines.speaker: helpful_regular
lines.text: I can come along if the timing works. Let us avoid guessing at the objective.

lines.speaker: newcomer
lines.text: Thanks. I will check my mission log before we set a time.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Perfect. We can make a plan once we know everyone is on the same step.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: There it is! Congratulations!

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: A hard-earned reward. Well done, everyone.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Good work. Remember the party that helped make it happen.

lines.speaker: bold_adventurer
lines.text: I vote for the farther camp. Better challenge, better stories.

lines.speaker: cautious_adventurer
lines.text: The nearer camp suits our current party better.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Could we start nearby and decide after seeing how the group handles it?

lines.speaker: party_leader
lines.text: That is fair. We will reassess after the first round.

lines.speaker: bold_adventurer
lines.text: Deal. I can save my grand expedition for another night.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: I think that expedition has earned a nickname.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Only if everyone who was there is comfortable with it.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Then let it be a fond memory, not a label we force on anyone.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: Thanks for coming, everyone. How did the plan feel from your side?

lines.speaker: helpful_regular
lines.text: The meeting point worked well. We could have shared the supply list earlier.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Agreed. The pace was good, and nobody was left behind.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: I will include the supply list next time. Appreciate the feedback.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Glad you could join us. We will keep the first outing relaxed.

lines.speaker: newcomer
lines.text: Thanks. I am still learning how this group does things.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Ask whenever you need to. We will explain as we go.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: And if you prefer to listen for a while, that is fine too.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: We missed you tonight, but no worries. We will share the next plan when it is ready.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Schedules happen. No one should feel they owe the Linkshell an explanation.

lines.speaker: curious_member
lines.text: I heard there is a new shortcut to the camp. Is that true?

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: I have not verified it. Let's check a reliable source before recommending it.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Until then, we should stick to the route we know.

lines.speaker: curious_member
lines.text: Fair enough. I will mark it as unconfirmed.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: A peaceful night. Anyone have a small adventure planned?

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Not tonight. I am happy just listening to the Linkshell.

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: Then I will keep the chatter gentle. Enjoy the quiet.

lines.speaker: party_leader
lines.text: Before we go, let's agree how drops and treasure will be handled.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: Clear rules now prevent awkward surprises later.

lines.speaker: helpful_regular
lines.text: And if the plan changes, everyone should agree before we continue.

lines.speaker: party_leader
lines.text: Agreed. I will state the rules before the first pull.

lines.speaker: returning_member
lines.text: I have been away for a while. What have I missed?

lines.speaker: social_butterfly
lines.text: A few adventures and plenty of ordinary evenings. Nothing you need to catch up on all at once.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: Welcome back. We can fill you in when you have time.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: Let's pause here. We can revisit the issue when everyone has had a moment.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: No one needs to settle this in the middle of an argument.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: The event can wait. Respect comes first.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: We have a roster change. Let's check whether the objective still fits.

lines.speaker: party_leader
lines.text: We can adjust the plan rather than pressure anyone to fill a slot.

lines.speaker: helpful_regular
lines.text: I can suggest a smaller objective if that helps.

lines.speaker: linkshell_leader
lines.text: Good. I will update the announcement before we depart.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: It has been a while since we adventured together.

lines.speaker: veteran_mentor
lines.text: It has. No need to explain the gap. We can pick up whenever it suits us.

lines.speaker: quiet_regular
lines.text: I would like that. A relaxed outing sometime soon.

design.purpose: Let the player build and adventure with a small roster of custom squad mates whose voices reflect who the player made them, without turning race or gender into a personality.
roster_rules: The player may create four to six squad mates (default roster capacity 6).
At most five may be deployed at once, so the player plus squad fits a six-member party.
Benched members do not act, speak, or gain field experience while benched; they are not pretending to be elsewhere.
A squad mate is a stable persona id plus player-chosen identity fields; changing a name or job does not create a new persona.
party_rules: Squad dialogue is only eligible while the member is actually deployed and the party state supports it.
A squad mate never claims a kill, drop, level, mission completion, or attendance that the server did not confirm.
Squad members may comment on a verified event, their own role, the player's visible loadout, and the current zone.
No romance, flirtation, or sexual content. Bonds are camaraderie and trust.
customization_rules: The player chooses name, race, gender, home nation, role, jobs, persona, address preference, and chatter frequency.
Race and gender may change pronouns, address forms, and lived-experience flavor only.
Race, gender, nation, and job must never change temperament, intelligence, loyalty, or competence.
Customization changes are acknowledged only after the server confirms them (job change, gear change, rename).
Player-supplied names are filtered for slurs, impersonation of staff or players, and reserved terms.
voice_rules: Layer 2: trait-fit variants, used only when the member matches the tags.
Layer 3: role lines (tank, healer, damage, support, hybrid).
Layer 4: familiarity tier (new, steady, trusted) earned from verified shared events.
Layer 5: current state (town, field, combat, low health, downed, benched, returning).
Prefer one authored variant over runtime word substitution; only documented tokens may be filled.
truthfulness: Zone, party, health, defeat, raise, loot, level, and completion claims require server state or events.
Rumor and speculation must stay phrased as uncertainty.
A benched or offline member cannot narrate activity.
privacy: Squad chatter respects the player's mute, quiet-hours, and opt-out settings.
No storage of private chat; familiarity derives from verified shared events only.
The player can rename, re-spec, bench, or retire a squad mate at any time.

You picked me for this. I will try to be worth the slot.

One rule from me: tell me when to hold and when to move. I will do the rest.
I will keep you standing. Try to make that easy for me.
Put me where the hits land. I will keep them off you.
I hit what you mark. Nothing clever unless you ask.
On it.
Following.
Holding here.
I will stay put until you call.
Understood. Regrouping.
Two incoming. I have the near one.
I have the first one. Let it come to me.
Pulling now. Hold your damage.
Casting. Stay in range.
I need a breath before the next pull.
Ready when you are.
Buff is up. Say when you want the next.
I can hold or heal, not both. Pick one.
I am low. Cover me for a moment.
Taking a beating here. A cure would be welcome.
Armor is holding, but I could use a hand.
That went better than it had any right to.
Check your supplies before we move.
If we keep pulling like that, we will run out of luck before we run out of targets.
I am fine. Check the others first.
Good pace. I can keep this up for a while.
I am down. Do not spend the whole fight on me.
Get me up when it is safe, not before.
Still here. Just not standing yet.
We lost that one. Regroup and talk it through.
No shame in a retreat. I would rather try again than argue.
Take a minute. Then we go again.
Thank you. I will not make you do that twice.
Up and moving. Give me a moment to find my feet.
That is twice you have pulled me back. I owe you.
I will check the shops while you sort your gear.
This city is louder than I remembered.
Do you need anything before we leave? I would rather ask now.
If you are changing jobs, tell me. I will adjust.
The guards keep looking at me. Probably the weapon.
I will be at the gate when you are ready.
Quiet out here. I prefer it that way.
The road bends east. Want me to scout ahead?
Something moved in the grass. Probably nothing.
Good ground here. We could rest if you need it.
I will keep watch while you check the map.
Nothing on the horizon. That usually means something is hiding.
You are standing in my light.
I called the left. You took the left.
Next time, warn me before you do that.
You always say that, and then it works.
Keep your voice down. Something is listening.
Do not make me choose between you and the plan.
I am still learning how you work. Give me time.
You do not have to explain everything. Just tell me what you need.
You call, I move. That is how this works now.
I have seen enough to know you will not waste us.
You have never left me on the ground. I remember that.
Whatever we are walking into, I am with you.
New gear? It suits you. Try not to scratch it.
You changed jobs. I will adjust my place in the line.
That is a different look. I am not complaining.
If you are switching to healer, I am moving to the front.
Tell me the plan before you change your mind again.
Your new blade is louder than the old one. I heard it from the gate.
Benched, not gone. Call me when you need me.
I will keep training while you are out.
Take someone who fits the job. I will be here.
Do not apologize. It is a roster, not a verdict.
I will be at the usual place. You know where to find me.
There you are. I was starting to think you found a better squad.
It has been a while. You look like you have stories.
I kept your gear clean. Do not ask how.
Welcome back. Same formation as before?
No grand destiny in my family. Just a road, a job, and a reason to keep walking.
Hume towns are all the same at night. One lamp, one argument, one open door.
San d'Oria taught me to stand straight. The road taught me to duck.
We are a proud people. It gets in the way of asking for directions.
The grass is taller than I am out here. I can still see the road.
Everyone pats my head in town. I have started charging for it.
The wind carries smoke from the east. Probably someone's dinner, not trouble.
People expect me to be quiet. I am quiet because I am listening.
Mind the doorway. I keep forgetting how low they build them.
I have been many places. None of them had a chair that fit.
I answer to {name}. 'Miss' is fine if you are being formal.
They wrote 'she' in the ledger. The rest of me is my own business.
You can stop calling me 'the one with the map'. I am the one with the map.
I answer to {name}. 'Sir' only if you are being formal.
They wrote 'he' in the ledger. The rest of me is my own business.
You can stop calling me 'the quiet one'. I am quiet because I am working.

lines.text: Front is mine. Stay behind the shield until I have them turned.
I will keep an eye on everyone. Say something if you are hurt.
I will wait for your mark. No heroics.
This one hits harder than the last. Give me a moment to settle it.
I am spending everything I have. Do not pull another yet.
I can burn it down, but I will need cover.
One more cure and then I am empty.
That was my fault. I lost the second one.
We can talk about fault after we are all standing.
Same camp, better spacing. I am ready when you are.
Sit down before you fall down. I mean it.
I will take first watch. You two eat something.
Ten minutes. Then we move before something finds us.
I will hold the fort. Try not to need me.
Go on. I will keep an eye on the others.
You came back. I was starting to like the quiet.
Let me look at you. You are thinner than I remember.
Same formation, then. I will take the front.
